name: MYB proto-oncogene like 1

function.text: MYBL1 encodes myb-related protein A. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of piRNA transcription.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Adenoid cystic carcinoma of breast; Adenoid cystic carcinoma of salivary gland. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
